title: Kont-niébé (Maize and White Bean Stew, Northern Cameroon)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: The same method as Corn-tchap but with white (niébé) beans cooked about 20 minutes instead of 1½ hours, then 5 minutes together with the fried seasoning base.
longDesc: p. 9 of the October 2023 CIFOR-ICRAF/IRAD/Université de Ngaoundéré recipe book. 1 kg of maize grains and 750 g of white (niébé) beans, with the same seasonings as Corn-tchap. The maize is cooked about an hour; the beans about 20 minutes; both go into the roasted-onion and crushed-condiment base and simmer 5 minutes. The book’s two recipes differ only in bean type and bean time, as the source shows.
ingredients: Oil, tomato, bell pepper, white pepper, onion, parsley, celery, basil, garlic, ginger, salt, chilli, stock cube, rock salt — quantities not printed
steps: Cook the maize in water with rock salt about an hour. Cool and wash off the skins.
Cook the white beans in salted water about 20 minutes. Wash them.
Chop the onion and bell pepper; crush the remaining condiments.
Roast the onion, add the crushed condiments and simmer. Season with salt and the stock cube.
Add the maize and beans and simmer 5 minutes. Serve.
chefTips: Beans take about 20 minutes here against about 1 hour 30 in Corn-tchap.
The printed cue for the maize is that the skins loosen and wash off.
commonMistakes: Using the Corn-tchap bean time for white beans.
Leaving the skins on the maize.
Over-salting from the rock salt and stock cube together.
healthBenefits: Maize and white beans give carbohydrate, protein and fibre.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Kont-niebe’ (p. 9). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 8, prep and rest values are placeholders. Quantities and times TWO-PASS; the text SINGLE-PASS.
ABSENT: seasoning quantities. The bean time (about 20 minutes) differs from CMR049 (about 1 h 30), as printed.
